_comment: Target structure sketch for the stage layer, additive to schema v0 (no breaking change). development_stages lives alongside events/candidates/confirmations; event ids reference the example project's archive-records.json. trace_touchpoints hold a few representative event ids per stage; the full list stays queryable via events[] time ranges. Times normalized to UTC+8.

development_stages.title: 初始化与数据层
development_stages.goal_or_scope: 建立仓库骨架,并落定为后端服务的数据模型与存储。

development_stages.title: 后端 REST API
development_stages.goal_or_scope: 让书籍与分类数据可通过统一接口访问。

development_stages.title: 前端脚手架与数据接入
development_stages.goal_or_scope: 建立前端工程结构,并打通到后端的访问通道。

development_stages.title: 前端功能界面
development_stages.goal_or_scope: 覆盖记录的功能目标——列表、搜索、表单、分类管理。

development_stages.title: 修复与文档收尾
development_stages.goal_or_scope: 修正接口行为差异,补齐项目文档。
